'''Galleros''' was the primary continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zelos II]]. It was renamed in honor of the [[Mandated Commander of the People of Zelos]], [[Galleros Nul]]. It was the location of the planet's [[City/Legends|cities]]&mdash;[[Drev (city)|Drev]], [[Kryndyn]], [[Lyn (city)|Lyn]], [[Lyrd]], [[Nul]], and [[Tolk]]&mdash;as well as the [[Valley of Umbra]].
